name: cronos
description: Cronos - Orquestrador em Node + React com TypeScript

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "server,realtime,web" -c "blue,magenta,green" "npm --silent --workspace=@cronos/server run dev" "npm --silent --workspace=@cronos/realtime run dev" "npm --silent --workspace=@cronos/web run dev"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:server && npm run build:realtime && npm run build:web
scripts.docker:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d
